# Shared q-value corpus — the parity oracle for the two deliberately
# duplicated parsers: the root module's compression_qvalue.go and the
# endpoints sub-module's qvalue.go. Both modules' tests assert THIS file, so a
# semantic change on one side cannot ship silently in the other.
#
# Format: <Go-quoted input><TAB><expected>, one case per line. Blank lines and
# lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#   value:<float literal>  the parser returns that float64
#   err:<sentinel name>    errors.Is(result, that sentinel) must hold
# Sentinel names: errEmptyQValue, errInvalidQInt, errTrailingQChars,
# errQValueTooLarge.
#
# The root file is canonical; endpoints/testdata/qvalue-corpus.txt is a
# byte-identical mirror because a nested module directory is excluded from the
# root module zip (the sub-module must carry its own copy). Keep them
# byte-identical — scripts/check-qvalue-corpus-sync.sh enforces it, and both
# modules' corpus tests must pass in the same change that touches the parser.

# Bare integers.
"0"	value:0
"1"	value:1

# Three fractional digits (the RFC 9110 maximum) including the boundary.
"0.5"	value:0.5
"0.100"	value:0.1
"0.010"	value:0.01
"0.001"	value:0.001
"0.123"	value:0.123
"0.555"	value:0.555
"0.999"	value:0.999
"1.000"	value:1

# An empty fractional part parses as zero (deliberately lenient: "0." is 0.0).
"0."	value:0
"1."	value:1

# Sign handling: "+" is accepted but neutralized, "-" is preserved as-is.
"+1"	value:1
"+0.5"	value:0.5
"-0.5"	value:-0.5
"-1"	value:-1
"-0"	value:-0
"-1.5"	err:errQValueTooLarge

# Empty input is rejected with its own sentinel.
""	err:errEmptyQValue

# The integer part must be a single "0" or "1" — no whitespace, no Unicode
# digits, no dot-first form, no bare sign.
"2"	err:errInvalidQInt
".5"	err:errInvalidQInt
"abc"	err:errInvalidQInt
" 1"	err:errInvalidQInt
"\t0"	err:errInvalidQInt
" "	err:errInvalidQInt
"\t\t"	err:errInvalidQInt
"+"	err:errInvalidQInt
"-"	err:errInvalidQInt
"\u0661"	err:errInvalidQInt

# Nothing may follow the parsed number: no junk, no extra digits, no space.
"1x"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0x"	err:errTrailingQChars
"00"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.5x"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.5."	err:errTrailingQChars
"1..0"	err:errTrailingQChars
"1 "	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.5\n"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.1234"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.9999"	err:errTrailingQChars
"1.0000"	err:errTrailingQChars
"0.123456789"	err:errTrailingQChars

# Anything above 1.0 is rejected once a fractional part is present.
"1.001"	err:errQValueTooLarge
"1.999"	err:errQValueTooLarge
